info.title: The Builder API
info.description: Clean Laravel 12 API. Proposed production API subdomain requires DNS and hosting verification. Health /up and Sanctum /sanctum/csrf-cookie are framework infrastructure, not legacy domain APIs. All dates are ISO 8601 UTC unless explicitly a calendar date. Editorial events return 404 while disabled.

servers.description: Proposed production origin; not deployed or verified

post.description: See the declared validation rules, required middleware, response resource and frontend route. Mutations persist to the relational database; privileged mutations record audit events. Browser requests must first GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie with credentials, then send the decoded XSRF-TOKEN cookie as X-XSRF-TOKEN. Cookies are HttpOnly for the session; no bearer token is issued.
